description: Accuracy history for SWIFT Wind AI. Enhanced forecast is compared with NOAA observed solar wind speed.

definition.hit_rate_50kms: percentage of points where |observed - predicted| <= 50 km/s
definition.hit_rate_75kms: percentage of points where |observed - predicted| <= 75 km/s
definition.hit_rate_100kms: percentage of points where |observed - predicted| <= 100 km/s
